excluded: referee aggregates updated with current/future match
featurePolicy.missingness: Training-fold median imputation plus explicit prior-unavailable indicators; transformer fit inside each fold.

targetDefinitions.yellowCards: Ordinary yellow-card key events assigned to athletes recorded as having appeared; includes a first yellow before a later second-yellow dismissal.
targetDefinitions.secondYellowCards: Red-card key events whose source text explicitly says Second yellow card.
targetDefinitions.directRedCards: Other red-card key events assigned to athletes recorded as having appeared.
targetDefinitions.totalCards: yellowCards + secondYellowCards + directRedCards. Provider boxscore yellow/red counts are retained separately and never substituted.
targetDefinitions.benchStaffPolicy: Events for rostered non-participants, staff or unresolved participants are excluded from individual/team/model targets and reported separately.
targetDefinitions.minutes: Derived after the match from starter, substitution and dismissal clocks (capped at 90/120, excluding added-time precision); outcome/exposure only, never a pre-match feature.

interpretationGuard: Referee B is retrospective on the full OOS set. Only rows whose designation evidence satisfies a named horizon can support horizon-specific pre-match claims. No probabilities are publication-ready.
